c74object.name: j.oscinstance
c74object.digest: Retrieve the instance addressed in OSC-like address
c74object.description: j.oscinstance allows to strip out the instance value (number or symbol) from an osc-like address

inlet.description: j.oscinstance leftmost inlet is used to send the osc address to strip out instance number

outlet.description: j.oscinstance first outlet output the incoming osc address with its instance value removed
j.oscinstance second outlet outputs the incoming osc address instance number or symbol
j.oscinstance second rightmost outlet outputs the value associated with the incoming address
j.oscinstance rightmost outlet outputs unmatching address
